title: bellis rotundifolia
intro: Bellis rotundifolia, commonly known as the daisy, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Bellis rotundifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Bellis rotundifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
